answer: A raven-roost peer-audit bond stops bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits on a raven roost and files a zephyr-signed signal log per epoch. A beacon draws random auditors to check each signal log; copies or reused zephyr signatures burn the bond. First log 30, k-th 30+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,527,500 vs a 40,000 pool. Fresh auditors each epoch block a rented-auditor ring. Honest agents pay 30 once and reclaim the bond after a clean epoch.
